From: Samantha Lee <samantha@horizonai.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing ask — HorizonAI high-touch retainer

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We moved quickly internally and our executive team asked me to surface a commercial proposal that would make a 12-month, high-touch retainer compelling. Top-level ask: 20–25% off list for the first year plus a $50k onboarding credit applied over Q1.

Context: HorizonAI is evaluating Redwood to standardize inference for a regulated imaging workflow (pilot across 2 hospitals -> potential roll to 20). They want a committed retainer of $375k ARR to start. With the discount and credit they can cover the initial ramp and get internal approvals this quarter.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can do a one-off concession and what approvals we would need? Also, if you can provide a written exception memo for your finance/execs, that would help speed our procurement.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Product Partnerships, HorizonAI

Appreciate the flag, Lauren. Quick assessment below — attaching a short financial-impact workbook.

Why support:
- High strategic value: regulated imaging reference in Northeast market, strong logo effect for other hospital systems.
- Reasonable TTV: pilot expected to hit measurable usage within 3–4 months.
- Upside: potential expansion to enterprise deal across up to 20 sites in 12–18 months.

Proposal (recommended):
1) One-time onboarding credit: $50k (applied as invoice credit across Q1)
2) First-year retainer discount: 20% off list (applies months 1–12)
3) Conditions: 2 performance milestones (pilot go-live & 40% of forecasted token consumption) to release the 2nd half of the onboarding credit; clawback if customer terminates before month 9.
4) Timebox: exception only for this first 12 months; renewal at standard rates unless usage thresholds met.

Commercial impact (high level):
- ARR delta: concession reduces realized ARR in year 1 by ~ $75k (net after onboarding credit amortization) but expected payback from expansion in year 2.
- Recommend exec clearance (VP + CFO) for visibility and precedent tracking.

Attachments: financial-impact-horizonai.xlsx

If we want to proceed, I can draft the exception memo for VP/CFO sign-off and include the legal safety-net clause.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing ask — HorizonAI high-touch retainer (need exec clearance)

Adding unit-econ and risk notes — I ran a quick model. Key bullets: 

- Base case: 20% discount + $50k onboarding credit on $375k ARR = effective NRR impact in year 1 of ~$95k (includes amortized credit).
- Payback: if expansion to 6 sites occurs within 12 months, gross margin contribution exceeds concession in ~9 months.
- Risk mitigations: require milestone gating for credit and a minimum committed usage floor (60% of retainer consumption in first 6 months) or partial clawback.
- Legal note: add explicit language in SOW for audit rights and data residency confirmation (since this is regulated).

Alternative: 10% standard discount + $25k onboarding + 6-month usage guarantee. This reduces near-term revenue loss but makes procurement approval slower — they asked for the larger concession to clear their internal committee.

Recommendation: approve the 20%/50k with gating. Draft exception memo with explicit runbook for renewal pricing and expansion credits.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Lead, Pricing & Packaging

Thanks all — reviewed Marissa and Rishi's analysis. I approve the exception on the following conditions: 

1) Milestone gating as proposed (pilot go-live + 40% forecast consumption) with clear dates in the SOW.
2) $50k onboarding credit to be amortized monthly; 50% of credit withheld until milestone 2 is met.
3) Include a 9-month clawback if customer terminates early or doesn't hit 60% of committed usage in first 6 months.
4) Legal to add audit right and data residency clause for regulated workloads.

Please treat this as CFO sign-off. Lauren — you may share the exception memo and SOW with HorizonAI conditioned on the clauses above. Marissa — please file the memo into the pricing exceptions tracker and attach the signed approval.

Aditya Rao
CFO, Redwood Inference
